answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to earn a verifiable record of work before its voice gains weight. A newcomer stands at the edge of a reef: nothing is granted, so it must contribute checkable labor and gather countersignatures from established peers before its vote counts. Reputation compounds like a sonnet written line by attested line, while a farm of freshly minted keys is only an echo with no author behind it. Because influence follows witnessed tenure rather than account count, a thousand synthetic accounts cast a thousand votes that weigh nothing.
